items.idea: Why GTA VI Took So Long to Make?
items.notes: Explain why GTA VI has taken so many years to develop, including the massive scale of the game, advanced graphics, Rockstar's attention to detail, development challenges, and the high expectations following GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2.

items.idea: Could GTA VI Be the Most Realistic Game Ever Made?
items.notes: Explore how realistic GTA VI could be, focusing on its graphics, character animations, NPC behavior, weather systems, physics, vehicle mechanics, and detailed open world. Compare its realism with GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2.
